paite: Huai zan in kumpipa a-ihmu thei kei; tanchin chiamtehna laibu hon tawi ding in thu apia a, huaite kumpipa ma ah asim uhi.
heading: Kumpipa'n Mordekai Apahtawi

paite: Kumpipa michilgehte lak a mi nih Bigthan leh Teresh, kongkhak vengte'n, kumpipa Ahasueras tung a khut khak sawmte tanchin Mordekai in agen chih kigelhna muh in a-om hi.
Huchi in kumpipa'n, "Hiai ziak in Mordekai tung ah bang zahtakna leh thupina hih in a-om a?" achi hi. Kumpipa sikha amah nasemte'n, "Amah a ding in bangmah hih a-om kei,” achi uhi.
Kumpipa'n, "Pisa a om kua ahia?" achi a. Huchi in Haman, kumpipa' inn pisa ponungzaw ah, kumpipa kiang a abawlkholhsa khailupna khuam a Mordekai khai ding thu gen ding in ahong hi.
Kumpipa sikhate'n akiang ah, "Ngai in pisa ah Haman adingh nilouh hi," achi ua. Kumpipa'n, "Hong lut heh," achi hi.

Huchi in Haman ahong lut hi. Kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Mi kumpipa'n azahtak nop tung ah bang kihih ding ahia?" achi hi. Haman in alungtang in, Kumpipa'n kei sang a pahtawi dia akipahna kua kiang a bawl nuamzaw ahia? achi hi.
Haman in kumpipa kiang ah, "Kumpipa'n apahtawi nopmi a ding in,
kumpipa'n asilh zel kumpi puansilh hon lakhia henla, sakol kumpipa tuan zelna leng, aluzang a lallukhu akoihna zel:

Huchi in puansilh leh sakol kumpipa vaihawmpih thupi penpente lak a khat khut ah pekheleh, huaite akumpipa'n zahtak a-utpa azeptheihna ding un leh khopi kongzing lak ah sakol tung ah tuangsak henla, ama ah, huchibang in kumpipa'n apahtawi nopte kiang ah hih in a-om ding, chi in puang leng," achi hi.

Huai laitak in kumpipa'n Haman kiang ah, "Kin inla, na chih bang in, puansilh leh sakol la inla, kumpipa kongpi a tu zel Juda mi Mordekai tung ah hih in: na gen tengteng bangmah vuaksuak kei hen," achi hi.
Huchi in Haman in puansilh leh sakol ala a, Mordekai azem a, khopi kongzing lak ah atuangsak a, ama ah, "Hichibang in kumpipa'n azahtak nopmi tung a ahih ahi ding,” chi in apuangta hi.
Huan kumpipa kongpi ah Mordekai ahong pai nawn hi. Himahleh Haman bel suun leh alutang khuhsa in a-inn lam ah kintak in apai hi.

Huchi in Haman in azi Zeresh kiang leh alawmte tengteng kiang ah atung a thil tung tengteng agen vek hi. Huaitak in amipilte leh azi Zeresh in akiang ah, "Ama a na puk patna Mordekai, Juda chi a mi ahihleh, amah na zou kei ding, himahleh ama ah na puk ngei ding," achi uhi.
Amah toh ahoulim san lai un, kumpipa michilgehte ahong pai ua, Esther in an nek ding abawlna a ding in kintak in hong pita uhi.
heading: Haman Kiakniamna
